title: Conformance baseline acceptance — 2026-11-23 (head a2c48db0)
body:
# Conformance baseline acceptance — 2026-11-23 (head a2c48db0)

## Context

The programme's conformance baseline was last accepted at snapshot `2a1ff31d` (2026-11-21). The head
snapshot `a2c48db0` proves that the Phase-G compliance reviews for T9, T10, T13 and T2 now exist, and
that 43 baseline entries no longer have a live gap. A report is not an acceptance; this record is
the delegated acceptance of the re-derived baseline.

## Decision

The baseline is re-derived from the head snapshot `a2c48db0`: 294 snapshot files and 279 published
outputs, audited against `governance/conformance.json`. Forty-three entries whose gap no longer
exists are deleted, not re-dated. The three live P1 gaps the snapshot proves are owned with the
programme owner and the 2027-02-18 reassessment date; each is a rework commitment, never a waiver:

- `seed_live_drift S21` — the plan says closed; the record says active. S21 is in tranches 9–11 and
  closes only after the chain authorises tranche 9.
- `seed_live_drift T0` — the plan says closed; the record says active. Tranche 0 is closed, so T0
  may close through its own chain.
- `seed_live_drift T4` — the plan says closed; the record says active. Tranche 4 is authorised, so
  T4 may close through its own chain.

## Consequences

The strict gate passes with zero unbaselined P0/P1 and no expired entry. S21 must not be closed
before tranche 9 is authorised; closing it earlier would manufacture the unauthorised-tranche P0.
The acceptance is a delegated act under the owner decision
`01a2021d-cca2-757c-bfc2-21bd4e4b6d85` (published 2026-11-22): the executor is `conveyor-e2e`, the
approver is `conveyor-approver`, and no human decision is claimed.

## Evidence

- Head snapshot: `a2c48db0`; 294 files; 279 published outputs; the manifest sha256 is recorded in the
  baseline header.
- Strict audit: `audit-programme-conformance.py --strict --fail-on P0,P1 --baseline
  docs/evidence/conformance-baseline.json`.
- Journal: the acceptance is replayed through `documents.compose` and read back by id.
